title: Round half-cent totals up, as invoices require
author: agent:session-a

requirement.problem: A customer reported that one line of 2.675 totals to 2.67. Invoices round half up, so the customer is undercharged by a cent.
excluded: Rounding of individual tax lines, which follows the tax authority's rule

acceptance.example: Given one line of 2.675, the invoice total is 2.68
Given a credit line of -2.675, the total is -2.68
Totals that were already exact, such as 2.67, are unchanged

risks: Other totals change if the rounding mode is applied too widely
plan.recovery: Yank 1.4.1 and keep 1.4.0 as the latest version
